Raff Ventures led the funding round, with participation from AJAX Capital Partners. Johnson succeeds founder Adam Farmer, who will remain actively involved as chairman. The leadership change follows The Farmer Companies’ acquisition of WHISPS and supports its strategy of building a leading North American cheese-snacking business. Johnson previously led Dot’s Pretzels, increasing the company’s annual sales from $19 million to $250 million in approximately three years.
